scope: Fourth 40-institution private-nonprofit discovery batch across Indiana, Kansas, Kentucky, Maine, Massachusetts, Michigan, Missouri, New Hampshire, New Jersey, New York, North Carolina, Ohio, Pennsylvania, South Dakota, and Texas
safeguards: Only official institution-owned employee pages or institution-specific ATS tenants were promoted.
Student and alumni career services were not treated as employee vacancy sources.
Shared healthcare and multi-campus boards were held when the institution could not be durably scoped.
Teach-out institutions and stale document-only references were held rather than treated as current employers.
